newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Rebound against bloc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Rebound against bloc.

text.p: Australian bonds rebounded against the dollar bloc as the local labour force report proved much weaker than expected, ending a run of largely bullish data on the economy.

However, the news was insufficient to totally drag the long end from its concerns over the U.S. market, which faces key data over the next two days for retail sales and the PPI, causing the local yield curve to steepen.
But despite this the Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread looked set to end the day at its lowest level since since the tail end of February.
February Australian employment dropped 7,200 against an expected 10,000 rise, which reflected a sharp 24,200 decline in full-time employment.
The unemployment rate also rose to 8.8 percent when it had been expected to remain unchanged at 8.6 percent.

The market also outperformed Canada, but remained outpaced by the short-end of the New Zealand curve after the RBNZ said it saw scope for monetary policy to ease when it announced its latest economic projections.
